text:
Tom (Marketing): quick sync — we need to lock topic + speaker slots for the May webinar. quick ideas: 'cost-aware LLM serving', 'benchmarks that buyers care about', or a short customer panel. thoughts?
Maya (Growth): my vote is benchmarks + a customer snippet. benchmarks drive signups.
Sean (Content): +1. suggest a 90s smoke-test demo showing latency vs $/1k tokens. keeps it tangible for buyers.
Tom (Marketing): agree. need 3 speaker roles: host (internal), product engineer (demo), and customer or solutions lead (use-case). who can host?
Rachel (Ops): greenroom availability check — free May 12 or May 19 afternoons. which is better for speakers?
Maya (Growth): May 19 preferred for APAC-friendly timing.
Sean (Content): I can draft 3 one-paragraph abstracts by EOD tomorrow. can ops confirm live demo access (network + model endpoints)?
Rachel (Ops): SamBot: preflight check for demo infra (embedding proxy + dedicated instance) on May 19 at 14:00 PT.
SamBot (deploy-bot): Preflight scheduled: uptime-check + token quota check for 5m window on 2026-05-19T14:00:00Z. Eng-runtime will be pinged.
Tom (Marketing): eng-runtime — any objections to a live demo that flips routing between hosted and dedicated mid-demo to show graceful fallback? @eng-runtime
Rachel (Ops): eng-runtime ok if we have a canary fallback and feature flag. I'll run a rehearsal with them on May 12 if we lock May 19.
Maya (Growth): leads routing: propose inbound param `webinar_source=benchmarks_may` so we can segment and route hot leads to AE queue. ops, can you add tag rule?
Rachel (Ops): yes. will add Zapier -> SFDC rule for `webinar_source` and auto-tag for AE. I'll also build the post-webinar survey flow.
Sean (Content): Draft abstracts:
- Abstract A: "Practical LLM Performance: What to Measure and Why" — latency buckets, cost per 1k tokens, short demo.
- Abstract B: "Serving Economics: Tunable levers that cut your inference bill" — batching, caching, quantization, routing.
- Abstract C: "Private deployment tradeoffs: customer stories & engineering" — customer panel + Q&A.
Tom (Marketing): good. prefer A+B or A+C (if we lock a customer). pick combo by EOD so we can lock speakers.
Maya (Growth): pinging AcmeHealth (potential customer) now — they liked our pilot; asking for a 10-min slot.
Tom (Marketing): rough 30m run-of-show suggestion:
```
00:00-02:00 - host welcome + agenda
02:00-12:00 - demo + benchmarks walk
12:00-20:00 - customer story / panel + live Qs
20:00-30:00 - CTAs, poll, next steps
```
We can stretch to 45m if customer wants deeper QA.
Sean (Content): demo script plan: warmup prompt, 1 high-latency long-context case, 1 cost-optimized quantized case, and a quick failure+fallback scenario. I'll draft prompts and timings.
Rachel (Ops): rehearsal plan:
- Tech dry run with eng + ops (30m)
- Full speaker rehearsal (45m)
- Backstage check 15m before live
I'll book those and send invites.
Tom (Marketing): speaker ask checklist: short bio, headshot, 3 talking bullets, availability for rehearsals (May 12, 14, 17). Please send by EOW.
Maya (Growth): CTA recommendation: gated benchmark report + 1:1 demo offer. we should A/B two CTAs. ops: can you route A->AE, B->self-serve playbook?
Rachel (Ops): yes. I'll wire two landing forms and tag flows for routing.
Sean (Content): we should auto-send a 3-slide follow-up pack (key benchmarks, cost tips, how to get started) to all registrants. I'll prepare.
Tom (Marketing): outstanding owners: pick topic combo (Tom), confirm customer (Maya), ops/rehearsal infra (Rachel), content assets (Sean). reconvene Tue EOD for final lock. :thumbsup:
